jobs.prompt: Board bug: the project page (/project?id=...) shows every section empty (Build progress, Split quality, Handled for you, Benchmark, Tickets, Runs, Lessons), no error. Root cause found in a real browser: in tools/watch-assets/project.js render() calls panel('spend', renderSpend), but the 'No money anywhere' change removed the #spend element from project.html, so renderSpend throws on a null element, and failedPanel then throws too (it does host.textContent on the missing element). That exception escapes render(); the .catch(function () {}) in load() swallows it, so none of the later panels render and nothing is shown. Fix: (1) delete renderSpend and the spend panel call (no money in the board). (2) Make failedPanel safe when the host element is missing (skip it, still console.error once). (3) In load(), replace the empty catch and the null case with a visible error: put a banner element (create it if missing, role alert, class board-empty or the existing error style) at the top of main saying 'Could not load this project: <short reason>' for a non-ok response, a JSON parse failure or any exception inside render, and remove the banner on the next successful render; keep polling. Also guard the three header lines in render. (4) Add tests/project-page-render.test.mjs: load tools/watch-assets/board-lib.js and project.js in a node vm with a small fake DOM (look at how tests/board-accuracy-page.test.mjs or tests/watch-assets.test.mjs already do this and reuse their helper if there is one), feed it a LARGE project payload built from a generated ledger of 220 tickets, 600 runs and 200 lessons through the real projectDetail from tools/board-data.mjs against a temp project, or a hand-built payload of the same shape, and assert: tickets, runs and lessons panels have children, the progress, split, benchmark and handled panels render, no panel shows 'failed to render', and that a payload that makes one panel throw still renders the others; and a failing fetch (500, bad JSON) shows the banner instead of blank sections. Keep the existing board tests passing (tests/board-*.test.mjs, tests/watch-*.test.mjs, tests/project-*.test.mjs).
